_source: Pass 50 of plans/evil-mode-rework/redesign-50 (pages gear, power, phase, teamup, crewin, legend, snap). Director 2026-11-21: give the mockups' pages simple real rules. Numbers are balance: tune here.

rules: One power after Day {after} of the first region.
One more each region, four at most.
Bosses who face you follow the same rule.
power.pick: Bzzt! More powers open in each new region.
power.picked: {gear} on. {name} is ready for your next fight.
power.none: No power yet. The first one opens after Day {after}.

changes.title: {his} team rallies
changes.text: Back on its feet, the lead with Attack +{atk}

changes.title: No rest for you
changes.text: Your team stays as it is

lines: Impressive. Now see what {team} really is.
Together, now! Hit them from three sides!
On three, Boss! We hit them first!

crewin.head: Who steps in?
crewin.about: A crew member fights first, then the Boss takes over.

assist.used: {who} hit {mon} first: it starts at {hp}% HP.

rocket.line: You lost, {boss}. {team} answers to me now... and so does the thing in the cave.

betrayal.won: {legend} breaks free and is gone. {admin} runs with nothing.
betrayal.lost: {legend} tears through your team and vanishes. {admin} runs after it.

snap.line: Bzzt! Click! That one is going on the wall.
snap.note: Snapshots show on your Boss card.
